name: Files
subtitle: Browse and organise Kindle files
description: Browse Documents and other supported user folders. Search by filename, create folders, rename, copy or move entries, and remove files and empty folders. Open PDFs, JPEGs, and PNGs in an installed Viewer, and supported books and PDFs in KOReader.

changes.notes: Changes user files when you create, rename, copy, move or delete them.

versions.notes:
Open supported documents in Viewer or KOReader.
Verified the Viewer handoff and return to Launcher on Kindle Oasis 3 (firmware 5.18.2).

Browse and search supported Kindle folders and manage files and folders. Open supported books and PDFs in an installed KOReader.
Installed and launched on Kindle Oasis 3 with firmware 5.18.2. Opened a sample PDF in KOReader.
